Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber grills, my last one was 10yrs old and was used year round out doors here in New England . Results.ReviewText: I don't want to date myself, but I have been using weber since the only thing you offered was the charcoal kettle.  Nothing grills quite like a weber and I have always done my thanksgiving turkey on the weber.....even during the charcoal days.  If I have one complaint, they just don't last the way they used to.  At one time they seemed indestructible, now they have a definite life.  I always keep it covered but it still seems to rust sooner than expected.  I do now live in Florida on a salt water canal, so this may be the difference.  I does not deter me for loving my weber thought.

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
